recipe.visualDefinition: A surrealist illustration of a spider-like creature where the cephalothorax and abdomen are replaced by two lustrous, iridescent pearls, rendered with fine-grained texture and soft shadows against a stark white background.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between organic, spindly dark legs and smooth, spherical pearls
Iridescent highlights on pearls reflecting ambient cool and warm tones
Soft drop shadows anchoring the subject to a flat white plane
Symmetrical yet organic leg arrangement creating a sense of frozen movement
coreInvariants: Two distinct pearls of unequal size
Dark, segmented, spindly legs with jointed articulation
Soft, diffused lighting with no harsh directional source

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centrally located, occupying approximately 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The larger, lower-left pearl serves as the primary focal point due to its size and luminosity.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the radial extension of the legs outward from the central pearl axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space isolates the subject, emphasizing its specimen-like quality.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Umber and Charcoal (legs and joints)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted Lavender and Pale Gold (pearl iridescence)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark legs and the bright pearls/background.
paletteRestrictions: No saturated blacks; use layered dark browns and grays

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution illustration of a spider-pearl hybrid on a clean white background. Use colored pencil textures for the legs and a smooth, pearlescent finish for the body segments. Ensure soft, realistic shadows underneath the legs.

verificationChecks: Ensure the pearls have a multi-tonal iridescence (pinks, blues, yellows).
Check that the legs appear segmented and organic, not mechanical.
Verify the background is pure white without any texture or gradient.

mustRedesign: Avoid photorealistic rendering; maintain a hand-drawn, illustrative quality.
Do not include a spider's head or eyes; the pearls must replace the entire body.

mustAchieve: Subtle nacreous texture on the spheres
Fine-line detail on the leg segments

postGenerationChecks: Are there exactly two pearls forming the body?
Is the texture reminiscent of colored pencil or pastel?
Do the legs have a dark, brownish-black organic tone?
recipe.reuseFormula: Surrealist [Subject A] + [Subject B] hybrid, rendered in [Medium] on [Background Color], focusing on [Specific Texture] and [Lighting Style].
